description: This file contains the implementation of a helper object for managing tables within the CCSP (Connected Computing Software Platform) framework, including creation, removal, and initialization functions, as well as internal data structures and function pointers.

classes.name: CCSP_TABLE_HELPER_OBJECT
classes.description: A structure representing the table helper object used within the CCSP framework, encapsulating configuration flags, callbacks, memory pointers, and queues for managing table data.

methods.name: void * CcspCreateTableHelper()
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new CCSP_TABLE_HELPER_OBJECT, setting default values and function pointers.

methods.name: void CcspTableHelperRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes and frees resources associated with a CCSP_TABLE_HELPER_OBJECT instance.
